datasets.licence_note: The same text in the ISO metadata of every SOTWIS source dataset (wosis_poly.datasets.metadata_xml); per source dataset in the notes of kind licence (isric_licence).
datasets.citation_note: No citation text in the SOTWIS metadata: the citation proposal of the ISRIC data hub per source dataset is in the notes of kind citation (isric_citation).

notes.title: SOTWIS_codes code list
notes.body: The SOTWIS_codes table (ATTRIBUTE, CODE, DESCRIPTION) is kept as its own code list, as in the source (decision B10 of #69): GET /code-lists/SOTWIS_codes, 1527 rows from 3 packages (Senegal and The Gambia, Tunisia, Upper Tana), the same 509 triples in each. It explains the codes of CLAF, CLAF_m (major soil groups), DRAI, ISOC, LITH, LNDF and PHAS; ISRIC Reports 2008/05 (p.23) and 2010/07b (p.18) only name it.
